category.description: Source category of discovered data, such as financial or personal information.

classification-id.description: Identifier of this classification record or definition.

classifier-id.description: Identifier of the classifier that produced the observation.

classifier-name.description: Name of the classifier that produced the observation.

confidentiality.description: Source confidentiality label assigned to the data.

detection-pattern.description: Pattern used by the source to identify the data.

lifecycle-state.description: Data lifecycle state in the source DLP observation.

pattern-match.description: Matched content reported by the source; include only when appropriate for the event's sharing scope.

reference.description: Source documentation or details URL for the classification.

size.description: Size of the classified data in the source's units; OCSF does not specify a unit for this field.

total.description: Total number of entities discovered by the classification job.

description: One data classification or DLP observation, including source category, confidentiality, classifier, lifecycle and detection context. It records source labels without imposing a universal classification vocabulary. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/data_classification, https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/data_security.
name: data-classification
